import json,os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']

import os,re,json,itertools
from collections import defaultdict,Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# Test hypothesis on demo4: out=3 iff exactly one panel has noise at (i,j), out=other bg if even? Compute with correct quadrant cells (i,j)->quadrant(i,j):
I=G['Demo pair 4 input']; O=G['Demo pair 4 output']
pairs=defaultdict(list)
for i in range(11):
    for j in range(11):
        n=[I[i][j]==2, I[i][j+11]==2, I[i+11][j]==2, I[i+11][j+11]==4]
        nv=sum(n)
        pairs[nv].append(O[i][j])
print({k:sorted(v) for k,v in sorted(pairs.items())})
